source_identity_algorithm: SHA-256 of sorted UTF-8 relative path + NUL + raw SHA-256(file bytes), over tracked and non-ignored untracked source. docs/evidence/, plans/progress.json, docs/agents/SESSION_HANDOFF.json and SHA256SUMS.txt excluded; each command is bound to the same local input tree.
scope: Read-only local GET /api/v1/sensors over verified C05 records and C10 applied configuration; exact GET proxy and accessible Sensors page show recent-event offline state (5-minute threshold), missing/expired applied configuration and durable spool gap count. Storage quotas and C10 verifier bounds are explicit local CLI options; no secret or policy is sent to the browser. No browser write path or persistence mutation was added.

fixtures.provenance: Repository-authored synthetic sensor events, applied config and durable gap; no customer or live sensor data.

results.positive: Real temporary C05 storage and C10 Ed25519 verification returned exact expected snapshot for expired/offline config with one durable gap, current config with recent event, missing config, and event at exactly the 5-minute threshold. Test confirmed API read left the durable manifest unchanged.
results.negative: Invalid method/path and incomplete CLI policy are rejected; storage/config recovery errors produce explicit unavailable responses; malformed versioned UI payload is rejected; exact proxy does not forward other paths or methods. Recovery test corrupts stored object and verifies fail-closed behavior.
results.compatibility: Full Go suite passed, including existing durable storage, replay, quota, spool overflow and ACK recovery regressions. API contains no write operation and sensorview uses no network imports.
results.discovery: npm check passed plan validation, production web/engine build, TypeScript typecheck and 55 Node tests; go test ./... passed; browser suite passed 5/5; go vet ./... passed.

security_review: The endpoint is exact GET and returns typed state only; all failures are generic and do not expose key material or storage paths.
Runtime requires explicit C05 storage quotas and C10 public key plus verifier bounds; the browser receives none of these values.
Web proxy binds to the local engine and validates response schema/size; browser uses no-store, credentials omit and a bounded request timeout.
No schema, migration, .env, Dockerfile, dependency, remote endpoint, or egress behavior was added.
limits: GitHub-hosted Actions were not triggered; hosted CI and hardware/provider conditions were not measured.
Offline means no accepted event newer than five minutes; it does not assert live network connectivity.
Implementation is committed locally as 188439d9456c1ed07f27cb40bd0f9d4f85d7f1e6; it was not pushed. GitHub-hosted Actions were not triggered.

environment.provider: No provider path used; C05 temporary local filesystem store

hardware: Not measured; local development host. Engine 2 vCPU / 2048 MiB RAM / 10240 MiB disk target remains C28 work.
